items.summary: Q: What about the battle with Lando? "Yeah, it was a good battle I think! Obviously quite a lot of back and forth between us. Would've loved to have held onto it, obviously, but no I think it was a good battle! I think I kinda had that kind of race with about three people during it so it was tricky. Obviously when you're against your teammate, you know what strengths and weaknesses they have and the car has so that makes things easier in some ways but more difficult in others. Yeah! I thought it was good."

items.summary: 🗣️ How are you gonna recover from the grid drop? "Try and get a good start, that's the biggest thing and yeah I'm not sure what race we're going to get to be honest. The slipstream is very powerful so we'll see if that keeps everyone bunched together. But also, we don't have that much energy to play with and you can use it in very different places through the lap so let's wait and see just how exciting the first few laps are. It's gonna be pretty action packed."

items.title_zh: X 发帖 @oscarpiastri81：当我把目标定在810美元时,我试图选择一个我们认为在9月底之前达到现实的数字。 我有点犹豫不决地想把它定得这么高,知道我们当中有这么多人仍然在学校/大学或在职业生涯的早期阶段。 我想给我们一些努力的东西,而不要给任何人造成任何压力,让他们作出比他们能够感到舒适的更多贡献。 但真正没想到的是, 在不到24小时内, 超过2400美元, 我非常感激所有捐赠、分享或帮助募捐活动的人, 我不认为我会永远停止 惊讶这个社区能完成什么 当我们决定在一起 为一些重要的事情。 我知道我一直在说谢谢 但我真的不知道该怎么用言语表达 我是多么感激你加入这样一个社区 我们的小生活是特别的。 还要向大家致以诚挚的感谢 也看到这么多人从这个社区的各个角落参与, 我可以在9月份一直坚持下去,并在未来围绕类似的倡议。 👊 当然了,卡利日快乐!
items.summary: When I set our goal at $810, I tried to choose a number that felt realistic for us to reach by the end of September. I was a little hesitant about setting it even this high, knowing that so many of us are still in school/uni or in the early stages of our careers. I wanted to give us something to work towards without creating any pressure for anyone to give more than they comfortably could. But what I really… truly didn’t expect was that in less than 24 hours, we would raise ALMOST TRIPLE that amount! 😭💙 More than $2400 with the official and additional fundraiser combined! I am so incredibly grateful to every person who has donated, shared, or helped this fundraiser reach more people. I don't think I'll ever stop being amazed by what this community can accomplish when we decide to come together for something that matters. I know I keep saying thank you, but I genuinely don't know how else to put into words how grateful I am to be part of a community like this. Our little 🐝hive is a special one. And a huge thank you as well to everyone from the wider f1twt. I’ve also seen so many people participating from all corners of this community and it makes me so happy to see us all come together for causes like this (even if we spend a lot of our time here arguing about racing). :) I hppe we can keep this going throughout September and rally around similar initiatives in the future. 👊 And of course, happy quali day!

items.title_zh: X 发帖 @oscarpiastri81：Oscar在签署McLaren续约时提到的一件事是，在与车队共事一年后，他知道了每个人的名字（并在多次采访中将此列为与菜鸟赛季相比最大的变化之一，显然他觉得这很重要）。不久后，Tom谈到他如何记住关于人的小细节，以及他如何与车队建立了如此个人化的关系，这让人“竭尽全力支持他”。现在，Morgan说他最可爱，会和你聊很久，Baz之前也以几乎相同的方式描述他。在他保留的McLaren之外的所有关系中，你也可以看到同样的情况。他仍然和以前的Prema的人足够亲近，可以和他们坐下来共进晚餐，仍然和前Alpine同事玩游戏，他的母校多年后仍在庆祝他拥有“非凡的人类价值观”。即使他长大了，在职业生涯中达到了新的高度，有一件事始终如一，那就是Oscar总是抽出时间与人相处，无论走到哪里都建立真诚的关系。他的前经纪人曾说，小时候他“总以为每个人都是他的朋友”，很明显那个小Oscar还在那里。所以，不管有些人怎么试图描绘他，重要的是那些真正和他一起工作过的人（更重要的是，那些在停止合作后很久仍继续认识他的人）以及他们如何谈论他……他们的说法完全一样：一个极其善良、友好、脚踏实地的人。🧡
items.summary: One thing Oscar mentioned when he signed his McLaren extension was that, after a year with the team, he knew everyone’s name (and cited this as one of the biggest changes compared to his rookie year in multiple interviews, which he clearly found important). Shortly after, Tom spoke about how he remembers little details about people and how he’s built such a personal relationship with the team, something that makes people move “heaven and earth to support him.” And now, you have Morgan saying that he’s the sweetest and will talk to you for ages, with Baz describing him in much the same way a while back. And you can see the same thing in all the relationships he’s kept outside of McLaren too. He’s still close enough with his old Prema people to sit down for dinner with them, still plays games with his former Alpine coworkers, and his old school is still celebrating him years later for possessing “exceptional human values.” Even as he grew older and reached new heights in his career, one thing that stayed consistent and that is Oscar’s pattern of always making time for people and forming genuine relationships wherever he goes. His former manager once said that, as a kid, he “always thought everyone was his mate,” and it’s clear that little Oscar is still there. So, no matter how some people try to paint him, what matters are the people who have actually worked with him (and, more importantly, continued to know him long after they stopped working together) and how they speak about him… which is exactly the same way: as someone who is extraordinarily kind, friendly, and down to earth. 🧡
items.summary_zh: Oscar在签署McLaren续约时提到的一件事是，在与车队共事一年后，他知道了每个人的名字（并在多次采访中将此列为与菜鸟赛季相比最大的变化之一，显然他觉得这很重要）。不久后，Tom谈到他如何记住关于人的小细节，以及他如何与车队建立了如此个人化的关系，这让人“竭尽全力支持他”。现在，Morgan说他最可爱，会和你聊很久，Baz之前也以几乎相同的方式描述他。在他保留的McLaren之外的所有关系中，你也可以看到同样的情况。他仍然和以前的Prema的人足够亲近，可以和他们坐下来共进晚餐，仍然和前Alpine同事玩游戏，他的母校多年后仍在庆祝他拥有“非凡的人类价值观”。即使他长大了，在职业生涯中达到了新的高度，有一件事始终如一，那就是Oscar总是抽出时间与人相处，无论走到哪里都建立真诚的关系。他的前经纪人曾说，小时候他“总以为每个人都是他的朋友”，很明显那个小Oscar还在那里。所以，不管有些人怎么试图描绘他，重要的是那些真正和他一起工作过的人（更重要的是，那些在停止合作后很久仍继续认识他的人）以及他们如何谈论他……他们的说法完全一样：一个极其善良、友好、脚踏实地的人。🧡
